etymology.historical_story: The packet provides no definition, source context, pronunciation, or Jawi spelling for this form. A separate Scots dictionary records goldie for several unrelated referents, illustrating why spelling alone cannot establish the intended Malay meaning. That evidence does not demonstrate borrowing into Malay. The entry therefore remains unresolved until its original sentence or a reliable Malay attestation becomes available. [Scottish National Dictionary](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/goldie)
